q: What carbon data should a buyer ask a Sohar polypropylene supplier for?
title: Sohar polypropylene: supplier carbon data
short: Ask for a cradle to gate footprint per tonne of the grade you buy, calculated under ISO 14067 or the GHG Protocol product standard, with the year and the share from feedstock, process fuel and electricity. Use it with the tonnes on your invoices; without it, use a published average and label it.
audience: Converters, packaging and textile makers buying polypropylene from Sohar

ul: Cracker or propane dehydrogenation fuel and power.

p: Not in the current scope, which covers cement, iron and steel, aluminium, fertilisers, hydrogen and electricity. The Commission has a review of organic chemicals and polymers under way, so check before each year.
Tonnes bought times the supplier figure goes in Scope 3 Category 1.

senseible: Senseible reads purchase invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record, so each supplier figure in your Scope 3 sits next to the quantity and the document it applies to.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
